subject: general
question: Who wrote the famous Sanskrit play Svapnavasavadattam?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Bhasa.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__****

__
 
• Predating Kalidasa, **Bhasa** is **one of the earliest** and most well-known Sanskrit playwrights in India.
 
• His name was already well-known by the** 1st century BCE**, and he most likely lived during the** late Mauryan period** (322-184 BCE).
 
• His plays had been lost for decades until** Ganapati Shastri,** an Indian scholar, found the** manuscripts in 1913.**
 
• **Svapnavasavadattam** is a six-act Sanskrit play written by Bhasa, an ancient Indian poet.
 
• It is a continuation of his prior drama, **Pratijnayaugandharayana,** in context.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shudraka__:**

 __
 
• ​He was an Indian playwright who wrote **three Sanskrit plays**: **Mrichchhakatika** (The Little Clay Cart),** Vinavasavadatta,** and a **Bhana **(short one-act monologue), **Padmaprabhritaka.**
 
• He was a** king, **according to the prologue of Mrichchhakatika; one idea suggests he was an** Abhira ruler **from the third century.
 
 
 
• **Jayade__v:**
 __
 
• He was a Sanskrit poet during the **12th century. **
 
• He is best known for his epic poem **Gita Govinda**, which focuses on Krishna's love for Radha, a gopi, at a spring rite.
 
• Jayadeva is the** oldest known author** of** hymns** found in the **Guru Granth Sahib.**
 
 
 
• **Kalidas__:**
 
 
• Kalidasa was a **Classical Sanskrit author** who is often regarded as the** greatest poet **and** playwright **of ancient India. 
 
• His plays and poetry are primarily based on **the Vedas, the Rāmāyaṇa, the Mahābhārata, and the Purāṇas.**
